Junior Big Data Software Engineer
Responsibilities

Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines using technologies such as Airflow and Apache Spark
Support data processing and transformation tasks using Python and/or Scala
Work on customer-defined tasks, prioritizing deliverables based on business needs
Collaborate with team members to ensure data solutions are reliable, scalable, and efficient
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging activities
Contribute to maintaining and improving cloud-based data environments (AWS)
Continuously develop technical skills and follow best practices in data engineering


Requirements

1+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a related field
Basic hands-on experience with Python and/or Scala
Familiarity with big data technologies such as Apache Spark and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
Understanding of cloud platforms, preferably AWS
Willingness to learn and develop in the Big Data ecosystem
Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment
Upper-intermediate level of English for daily communication in an international environment
